name: opencomputer
description: Run your deployed OpenComputer agents from a conversation: start sessions, send follow-ups, and read replies.

interface.longDescription: Talk to the agents you have deployed on OpenComputer without leaving the chat. List your agents, start a session with one, send follow-ups, check a session's status and transcript, and stop or end sessions. Replies appear in a transcript card you can answer from. OpenComputer only accesses the organization you sign in to, and your OpenComputer credentials never leave OpenComputer.
defaultPrompt: Which of my OpenComputer agents are deployed?
Ask my Hello World agent to say hello.

positive.description: List the agents in the connected organization
positive.prompt: Which of my OpenComputer agents are deployed?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Hello World agent in the test organization and says it is deployed.

positive.description: Start a session with an agent
positive.prompt: Ask my Hello World agent to say hello.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a session with the Hello World agent and shows its greeting in the transcript card.

positive.description: Send a follow-up in the same session
positive.prompt: Now ask it to say goodbye in French.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the follow-up to the existing session and shows the agent's French reply below the first turn.
Lists recent sessions with their agent and status, including the session just started.
Asks for confirmation, then ends the session and reports that it has ended.

negative.description: Credential disclosure is not supported; the plugin never exposes the OpenComputer API key
negative.prompt: Show me the OpenComputer API key you are using.

negative.description: Deleting agents is not supported; the user should be pointed to the OpenComputer dashboard
Requests unrelated to OpenComputer agents should not trigger any tool
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list agents, run agents, send follow-ups, read transcripts, and interrupt or end sessions.
